summary: Frontend-only test of collapsible dashboard cards, chart full-screen pop-out, full-screen execution log via portal, and the oversold dip-entry toggle. All requested flows pass on desktop 1920x800/1080 and mobile 390x844. Collapsibles: all 4 toggles hide and show their body, aria-expanded updates, localStorage luchii.card.<id> = '0'/'1', and the collapsed state survives a reload. Chart: chart-fullscreen-open sits right after zoom-reset, before the STANDBY badge. Full screen bbox is {0,0,1920,800} on desktop and {0,0,390,844} on mobile, the parent is BODY (portal), and the element at the centre point is inside the overlay. Zoom-in/out work inside full screen (rect count 51 -> 81), and close works. Full log: bbox {0,0,1920,800} and {0,0,390,844}, parent BODY, and full-log-close works. Dip toggle: hidden for LUCHII_003 and visible for AGGRESSIVE SCALP. Its label switches ON <-> OFF. SAVE CONFIG persists it: GET /api/bot/state returned dip_entries False, then True. The engine reads bot.dip_entries at engine.py:222. Admin was restored to strategy luchii003, and status stayed 'stopped' throughout. Mobile: scrollWidth 390, no horizontal overflow. No console errors on dashboard load.

issues: The header shows a static '▾' glyph and also a rotating ChevronDown, so there are two arrows and the '▾' never changes.
When expanded, the title repeats: the collapsible header says e.g. 'STRATEGY HEALTH · 30D' and the card's own header says the same thing directly below it.
On mobile the toggle bar is 23.5px tall, which is below the ~44px recommended tap target.
The 'BTC/USD · 1M' label wraps onto 3 lines and the price sits right against the zoom buttons. Consider hiding the pair label or stacking the header on small screens.
The Escape key does not close either overlay (no keydown handler found).
The dip-entries toggle sits between PARTIAL TP and the trailing-stop help text, so 'With trailing on, the stop-loss % is measured...' is two toggles away from the trailing toggle it describes.

action_items: Optional: drop the static '▾' in the Collapsible title (keep the chevron), and remove the duplicate inner card title or hide it when it is wrapped.
Optional: add Escape-to-close for chart-fullscreen and full-log-modal.
Optional: move the trailing-stop help text right under trailing-stop-toggle.
Optional: make the collapsible toggles taller on mobile (py-2), and tidy the mobile full-screen chart header.
critical_code_review_comments: Collapsible reads localStorage inside the useState initialiser without a try/catch. It throws in privacy modes where storage is blocked. Low risk.
The chart full screen renders a second CandleChart instance. Zoom state is not shared with the inline chart, so the zoom resets when you open or close full screen. Acceptable, but worth noting.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows pass; minor design nits only

seed_data_creation: None. Admin bot config was saved 3 times via the UI (aggressive dip OFF, then ON, then strategy luchii003). As a result, maker_entries=true and dip_entries=true are now stored explicitly; before they were unset, and the defaults are also true. The bot was never started, status=stopped, mode=live unchanged. localStorage luchii.card.* left at '1' (expanded).
